start.text: Come in, come in. Okafor Lettings: forty years in Old Town, and I still remember every tenant's birthday.
You're here about the corner unit, I can tell. Everybody looks at it the same way.

before.text: A bakery, then a phone repair shop, then a café that opened too late in the morning. Old Town walks to work early.

cost.text: Nineteen hundred a month, two months' deposit. It comes empty: you fit it out, and City Hall wants a food licence before you sell a single croissant.
And the rent is due whether anyone buys a coffee or not. I say that to everyone. Some people listen.

end.text: Here are the papers. Read them. Then read them again.
